tasks.Calculate_Rest_Time: Calculate the total rest time by multiplying the number of rests by the duration of each rest (10 minutes)
tasks.Calculate_Ride_Time: Calculate the total ride time without considering any rests
tasks.Determine_Number_of_Rests: Determine the number of rest periods based on the distance covered per rest period
tasks.Total_Journey_Time: Sum up the ride and rest times to get the total journey time
